candidates.rationale: Pre-auth CVSS 10.0 file-upload RCE + auth CVSS 9.0 companion; part of an actively-exploited wave (Balbooa/iCagenda/Joomlack KEV-listed, some exploited pre-patch); published bypass mechanics; Swiss/EU municipal Joomla exposure. Clears gate via imminent-mass-exploitation profile. New CVEs not in store -> new entry (consistent with prior wave members as standalone entries).

Clearly relevant (public-sector+finance MFT, Cl0p mass-exploitation history, internet-facing pre-auth DoS reachable); national-CERT (CERT-FR) primary + CVSS + in-window. Severity doubt on a clearly-relevant item resolves toward include at supported priority (notable). No exploitation/PoC -> framed as patch-prioritization awareness, not urgent.

candidates.drop_reason: out-of-window: CISA's forensic postmortem ('Lessons from CISA's Cyber Incident') was published 2026-06-09 per Infosecurity Magazine (2026-07-10) — ~32 days before this run, well outside the 24h window. Phase 4 deep-read caught this: the jina metadata showed 2026-06-23 and S4 reported 2026-07-09, but the authoritative date is 2026-06-09. The 2026-07-08/10 trade-coverage wave (Infosecurity/SC Media/CyberScoop/Cybernews) is delayed pickup of a month-old CISA post, NOT a fresh in-window CISA development — publishing it now as new would be the 'month-old news as new' trap (fake-news guard). The original May incident is already in the store (entry 2026-05-19); no fresh in-window delta exists to hang an update on. Recoverable by the weekly if a genuinely new angle emerges.

borderline-drop: Keycloak 26.7.0 (CVE-2026-9796/9689/9798/11986). Thin single-vendor sourcing (release notes only; GitHub issue links 403'd on WebFetch + jina), no CVSS published, no exploitation/PoC (routine monthly release), and primary dated 2026-07-09 (~60h, outside the 24h floor). Relevance to constituency not in doubt (EU public-sector IdP), but the vulnerability gate requires action beyond the regular patch cycle and the sourcing/recency are below the bar for a clean entry. Recoverable via a future update if exploitation emerges.
